name: metro-alert
description: GPS metro stop alarm: set a destination, get vibration + sound when you're close.

scripts.serve: npm run vendor && npx --yes http-server www -p 8080 -c-1
scripts.android: npm run vendor && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.js android && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run vendor && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.js ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync
